title: Englwartinger Straße, Höhenkirchen-Siegertsbrunn
description:
Enjoy a spacious 200 m2 home in the peaceful community of Höhenkirchen-Siegertsbrunn, just south of Munich. Perfect for families, relocation stays, business travelers and project teams, the apartment offers five fully furnished bedrooms, a modern kitchen, balcony, private parking and high-speed Wi-Fi. The S5 S-Bahn provides convenient access to Munich city centre in around 30 minutes while enjoying a quiet residential setting.

⸻

Welcome to this spacious and fully furnished 200 m2 apartment in Höhenkirchen-Siegertsbrunn, designed for comfortable stays whether you’re relocating, working on a project, travelling with family or visiting Munich for an extended period.

The apartment offers five fully furnished bedrooms, making it ideal for larger families, colleagues or groups. Guests can enjoy a bright living room with comfortable seating and Smart TV, a fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher, oven, stove, refrigerator and all essential cooking equipment, a modern daylight bathroom with bathtub and shower, an additional separate toilet, a private balcony overlooking the surrounding greenery, high-speed Wi-Fi, a washing machine and a private parking space directly in front of the property.

Located in a quiet residential neighborhood, the apartment combines a peaceful atmosphere with excellent everyday convenience. Within a short walk you’ll find supermarkets, bakeries, cafés, pharmacies, restaurants, an organic food store and other local services.

Excellent public transport

* Höhenkirchen-Siegertsbrunn Station – approximately 12–15 minutes’ walk (1 km)
    * S5 S-Bahn with direct service towards Munich City Centre, Munich East Station (Ostbahnhof) and Kreuzstraße
* Munich Marienplatz – approximately 30 minutes by S-Bahn
* Munich Central Station (Hauptbahnhof) – approximately 35 minutes by public transport
* Munich East Station (Ostbahnhof) – approximately 20 minutes by S-Bahn

Nearby bus connections

Within walking distance you’ll also find several MVV bus services:

* Bus 216
* Bus 240
* Bus 244
* Bus 456

These provide convenient regional connections to neighboring communities and surrounding business locations.

Nearby attractions & amenities

* Supermarkets, bakery, butcher and organic grocery store – 5–10 minutes’ walk
* Local cafés and restaurants – within walking distance
* Hohenbrunn Forest recreational area – just a few minutes away for walking and cycling
* Munich Trade Fair (Messe München) – approximately 20 minutes by car
* Munich City Centre – approximately 30 minutes by S-Bahn
* Alps and Bavarian lakes are easily accessible for weekend trips by car.

Whether you’re visiting Munich for work, relocating with your family or staying on a longer project, this apartment offers generous space, modern comfort and excellent transport connections.

⸻

Guests have exclusive access to the entire apartment, including all five bedrooms, the living room, fully equipped kitchen, bathroom, separate toilet, balcony and private parking space.

Self check-in provides flexibility for your arrival. Detailed check-in instructions are sent before your stay to ensure a smooth and convenient experience.

⸻

Our local mHomes team is available before, during and after your stay to assist with any questions or requests. We provide fast communication, local support and professional service while respecting your privacy, allowing you to enjoy an independent and comfortable stay.

⸻

* Entire private 200 m2 apartment
* Five fully furnished bedrooms
* Ideal for families, relocation guests, business travelers and project teams
* Bright living room with Smart TV
* Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher
* Bathroom with bathtub and shower
* Separate guest toilet
* Private balcony overlooking greenery
* High-speed Wi-Fi
* Washing machine
* Private parking space
* 12–15-minute walk to Höhenkirchen-Siegertsbrunn Station (S5)
* Direct S-Bahn connection to Munich city centre
* Walking distance to supermarkets, bakery, cafés and restaurants
* Quiet residential location with excellent access to Munich and the surrounding region
